elements.label: Background extra walking right and exiting behind the foreground pillar
Man turning his head toward the speaker
Woman's hand gesture over the desk

pattern.description: Locked-off, shallow-focus live-action two-shot: the woman talks and gestures ('my gaggle will automatically collect...') while the man turns to her and an out-of-focus extra walks out of frame behind a foreground pillar.
pattern.why_premium: Layered depth (blurred foreground pillar, actors mid-ground, moving background extra) makes the office feel lived-in and cinematic, carrying the narrative between product overlays.

build_hint.gsap: Footage only; no tween on the scene. Any recreation keeps the clip locked off; overlays (if added) would enter on the next line, not here.
build_hint.remotion: Single <OffthreadVideo> in a <Sequence>; no interpolate or spring needed.

notes: Camera verdict none; all motion is actor/extra movement in the footage. b01 is a union box overlapping b03/b04/b05 and was not used; b06-b08 are small fragments of the walking extra's hair/shoulder near b02 and were folded into b02.
